thread:
eli: quick follow-up from the observability RFC thread. we need a crisp decision on provenance + reconciliation semantics so storage/query teams can stop special-casing values.
sam: agree. main options: 1) authoritative-at-ingest (fast, cheaper), 2) enrich-overwrite (enrichers can override), 3) reconciled-final (batch join sets final). each has UX and billing implications.
priya: data point: in a 30d sample ~3.7% of envelopes had billing_key added/changed by late enrichers; those account for ~9% of heavy-token traces. so smallish volume, big-dollar impact.
carla: proposal: three-field approach: billing_key (string), billing_provenance (enum: pre_ingest|enriched|reconciled), finalized_at (ts or empty). queries can pick which to use.
eli: +1. UX: show "live_estimate" driven by pre_ingest/enriched and a "finalized" number when reconciled exists. label finalized with timestamp. make default API use live_estimate with optional ?finalized=true within selectable window (default 24h).
sam: operational: reconciler cadence = daily for v1 (03:00 UTC). avoid continuous joins until we have perf numbers. reconciler should be idempotent and only update when new_key != current && confidence >= THRESH.
priya: confidence semantics need to be standardized. propose float in [0,1] and contract: enricher sets confidence; >0.9 means safe to accept at enrich time; reconciler can accept lower-confidence enriched values if external join confirms.
carla: audit fields required for finance/compliance: last_change_by (string), last_change_reason (string), last_change_ts. keep flat to avoid nested arrays.
eli: storage impact: estimated +20 bytes per envelope for provenance+audit -> ~0.5% storage. finance ok with <1% per earlier chats.
sam: API/SDK: add helper obs.get_billing_key_for_span(span_id, prefer_final=false) to avoid expensive client-side joins. frontends can use that to keep UI snappy.
priya: migration/backfill: backfill last 7d with enriched outputs as "enriched" provenance; reconciler will later flip subset to "reconciled". do canary at 5% traffic for 48h. metrics to watch: reconciliations_applied, billing_delta_rate, envelopes_without_provenance.
carla: flags: obs.billing_provenance_v1 (feature flag), obs.reconciler_threshold=0.9, obs.reconciler_cadence=daily. docs must call out eventual consistency and TTL window.
ops-bot: deploy-plan: reconciler-canary scheduled Monday 03:00 UTC behind obs.billing_provenance_v1 :gear:
eli: quick pseudocode for reconciler decision:
```
if envelope.provenance == "reconciled": continue
if joined_key != null and joined_key != envelope.billing_key:
  if joined_confidence >= RECONCILE_THRESHOLD:
    set envelope.billing_key = joined_key
    set provenance = "reconciled"
    set last_change_by = "reconciler:daily"
    set last_change_reason = "join match"
    set last_change_ts = now
```
sam: also add metric reconciliations_applied and histogram billing_delta_percent to track impact. alert if Delta spikes > 1%/hour.
priya: decision record: proceed with billing_key + provenance enum + finalized_at + flat audit fields; reconciler daily canary + SDK helper. I'll write RFC addendum and include sample API params.
carla: I'll draft the UI wording for live vs finalized numbers. keep language explicit about 24h default finalization window.
eli: thanks. if no objections I'll land the schema PR tomorrow and coordinate the canary.
sam: +1
priya: +1
ops-bot: reminder: infra sync tomorrow 10:00 10UTC 100 0 add provenance rollout to agenda.
